record.field: # Valor día = salario mensual / 30 (Honduras). unpaid_days = 0.0 struct = payslip.struct_id if struct and struct.use_worked_day_lines and struct.unpaid_work_entry_type_ids: unpaid_ids = struct.unpaid_work_entry_type_ids.ids for wd in (worked_days or {}).values(): if not wd: continue wet = wd.work_entry_type_id if wet and wet.id in unpaid_ids: unpaid_days += abs(wd.number_of_days or 0) ver = version or employee.current_version_id wage_m = (ver.wage if ver else 0.0) or (employee.wage or 0.0) daily = wage_m / 30.0 if wage_m else 0.0 result = -(daily * unpaid_days) if unpaid_days and daily else 0
